articles.title: Stocktwits to Offer CME Group Futures Data to Its Community of 10 Million Investors & Traders
articles.mainIdea: Stocktwits to Offer CME Group Futures Data to Its Community of 10 Million Investors & Traders
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Stocktwits to Offer CME Group Futures Data to Its Community of 10 Million Investors & Traders. Stocktwits, the leading social platform for investors and traders, today announced that its users can access interactive charts, streaming prices and dedicated cashtag pages for futures symbols spanning the full suite of CME Group regulated futures contracts across equities, FX, cryptocurrency, energy, agriculture, metals and interest rates markets.

articles.title: What Friday's high-profile US jobs report means for Bitcoin price
articles.mainIdea: What Friday's high-profile US jobs report means for Bitcoin price
articles.summary: DLNews: What Friday's high-profile US jobs report means for Bitcoin price. The Department of Labor is set to release the March payrolls report on Friday. Bitcoin’s price depends on economic numbers more than crypto signals, analysts say. Related tickers mentioned: BTC-USD, GC=F.

articles.title: The bond market is helping resolve the Fed's interest rate dilemma
articles.mainIdea: The bond market is helping resolve the Fed's interest rate dilemma
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance: The bond market is helping resolve the Fed's interest rate dilemma. The Federal Reserve is looking to hold interest rates steady amid the Iran war, but markets have already priced in a rate hike. In the first month of the war, global short-term and long-term government bond yields have risen significantly. Related tickers mentioned: CL=F.
